blind.description: A wooden armor stand displaying a set of classical/fantasy armor. It features a four-legged cross-shaped wooden base supporting a central vertical pole. Attached to the lower half is a round wooden buckler shield with a green border and bronze/gold trim and central boss. The upper half holds a bronze and dark steel cuirass with shoulder pauldrons and pteruges, topped with a crested helmet featuring a red plume. All surfaces are solid, continuous, hand-painted stylized game-ready meshes with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it shows the crest of the helmet running vertically, the shoulder pauldrons extending outwards to both sides, the front edge of the shield/breastplate, and the ends of the cross-shaped wooden base visible at the edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5.0 feet tall (reaching roughly shoulder-to-neck height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide across the shoulders
